title: Engineering Drawing Viewer — Overview and definition
t: Engineering Drawing Viewer — Overview and definition
description: Opens, measures, and redlines 2D engineering drawings without a full CAD license.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Opens, measures, and redlines 2D engineering drawings without a full CAD license. An engineering drawing viewer renders DWG, DXF, and PDF drawings, supports pan/zoom, layer control, distance and angle measurement, and markup redlining for review cycles. Real implementations parse the DWG binary format or use the Teigha/ODA libraries, and many run in a browser via WebAssembly. Public examples include ODA Drawings Explorer, LibreCAD, and browser-based DWG viewers.

Measure distances, angles, areas, and calibrate scale from a known dimension
Toggle layers, freeze viewports, and inspect entity properties
Add redline markups, stamps, and review comments with authorship
Batch-convert drawings to PDF or image for distribution

title: Engineering Drawing Viewer — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Opens, measures, and redlines 2D engineering drawings without a full CAD license.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Engineering Drawing Viewer, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Open DWG, DXF, DGN, and vector PDF drawings including paper/model space). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Open DWG, DXF, DGN, and vector PDF drawings including paper/model space and Measure distances, angles, areas, and calibrate scale from a known dimension. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Technical Drawing Generator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
